game_concept: A action puzzle set in Eldritch Ruins – Collapsed Dome, a collapsed dome: the spirit seeker must handle rune wisps while practicing lists. Core idea – Comprehension Lab: Build new lists in one line with list comprehensions to transform relic shards.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Collapsed Dome: a collapsed dome
core_gameplay_loop: In Collapsed Dome, repeat each round: Build new lists in one line with list comprehensions to transform relic shards. Each round, a new relic shards challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the lab_output value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 130 points of relic shards by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 130, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 1 (intro tier): Comprehension Lab
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Comprehension Lab' (Week 7 slot 11), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Collapsed Dome'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Eldritch Ruins
region.mood: eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how lab_output changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against rune wisps in Collapsed Dome.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 130 within 24 seconds.
